# NEXKODE

> NEXKODE is a high-performance digital solutions agency specializing in full-stack web engineering, UI/UX design, and visual media production.

## Core Services

- [Full-Stack Engineering](https://www.nexkode.com/#services): Enterprise-grade web application development using Next.js, React, Spring Boot, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).
- [UI/UX & Product Design](https://www.nexkode.com/#services): Modern interface design, design systems, and conversion-focused user experiences.
- [Visual Media & Motion](https://www.nexkode.com/#services): High-converting video reels, motion graphics, and digital media production.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.nexkode.com/#services): Strategic digital brand management and social content optimization.

## Key Sections & Pages

- [Home](https://www.nexkode.com/#home): Main landing experience highlighting NEXKODE's core value propositions and digital solutions.
- [About NEXKODE](https://www.nexkode.com/#about): Detailed agency background, mission statement, and technical engineering approach.
- [Methodology](https://www.nexkode.com/#home): 4-step engineering process covering Discovery & Strategy, UI/UX & Architecture, Code & Visuals, and Launch & Scale.
- [Recent Deliveries](https://www.nexkode.com/#projects): Portfolio showcase featuring Prime Raw (Factory Inventory Automation Platform) and QuickHire (AI-Powered Hiring SaaS Platform).
- [FAQ](https://www.nexkode.com/#faq): Technical details on supported technology stacks, service integration, and project delivery timelines.
- [Contact](https://www.nexkode.com/#contact): Project intake form and direct contact points.
